summary: FAIL. All required commands and prefreeze pass on the frozen candidate 1a73d6f0 (7e99163). The A24/A25 regression suites pass (r8 86/86, r9 94/94, r10 8/8), as do the register, agent-load and feasibility checks and 9 of my 11 new round-11 cases. D-024's guard rules and exit 71 work as specified. F-DG0-225 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. One new Medium, F-DG0-226: under the runner's --setting-sources project,local, a shell-planted .claude/settings.local.json with disableAllHooks disables the write guard for later runs (proven live with the real CLI). Hidden via .git/info/exclude, or placed in a worktree cwd, it leaves no trace in the run evidence, contrary to D-024's detection claim. Two new Lows, acceptable as observations: F-DG0-227 (test_run_meta.py script mode skips the D-024 tests) and F-DG0-228 (probe source commits reachable only via the reflog).
